Build the `/settings/messaging` page for InkOS — the admin surface for auto-reply rules, message templates, signature, channel connections, business hours. Working dir: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

## Read these first
- `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/lets-build-whole-page-tender-petal.md` — "Settings surface" section (canonical)
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md` — brand rules section 4 (Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only; Inter + Instrument Serif; locked shadows; no tailwind.config.ts)
- Existing settings pattern: `app/(app)/settings/` — look at a completed settings page (e.g. `app/(app)/settings/studio/services/page.tsx` which is in git diff) to match the layout conventions + sidebar integration pattern

## Context — what's done
Backend wiring fully in place:
- Server actions in `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts` — `createTemplateAction`, `updateTemplateAction`, `deleteTemplateAction`, `createRuleAction`, `updateRuleAction`, `toggleRuleAction`, `deleteRuleAction`, `seedDefaultTemplatesAction`
- Queries in `lib/messaging/queries.ts` — `listMessageTemplates(studioId, {category?, channel?})`, `listAutoReplyRules(studioId)` (joins template)
- Mutations in `lib/messaging/mutations.ts` — full CRUD helpers
- Types in `lib/supabase/types.ts` — `MessageTemplate`, `AutoReplyRule` tables
- Default templates seed: `lib/messaging/templates-seed.ts` — 6 seeds ready

## Build

### 1. Route — `app/(app)/settings/messaging/page.tsx`
Server Component. Responsibilities:
- Resolve active studio via `getActiveStudio()` (existing helper — same pattern as `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx`)
- Feature-gate check: `requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, 'omnichannel_inbox')` — if 403, render `FeatureLockedCard` (check for existing component in `components/billing/` — if none, render inline "Upgrade to Studio plan" message w/ link to `/settings/billing`)
- Parallel fetch:
  - `listMessageTemplates(studioId)` — all templates
  - `listAutoReplyRules(studioId)` — all rules with `template` joined
  - Studio record (name, business hours, email signature, preferred tone) — from `supabase.from('studios').select('name, email_signature, messaging_business_hours, messaging_tone, messaging_connected_channels')` — if these columns don't exist, add them to the migration (see step 6).
  - Channel connection status — derive from env presence (SMS connected if Twilio env set; Email connected if Resend env set; IG/WA/WebChat not connected — v1)
- Metadata: `{ title: 'Messaging Settings — InkOS' }`
- Use `PageShell` (not fullHeight) + `PageHeader` (title: "Messaging", description: "Auto-replies, templates, signatures, and channel connections.")
- Render `<MessagingSettingsClient {...props} />`

### 2. Client — `app/(app)/settings/messaging/MessagingSettingsClient.tsx`
Use client. Receives all server-fetched data as props.

Layout: vertical stack w/ `space-y-6`. 5 cards in order:
1. **Channel Connections** card — `<ChannelConnectionsCard />`
2. **Auto-reply Rules** card — `<AutoReplyRulesCard templates rules />`
3. **Templates** card — `<TemplatesTable templates />`
4. **Signature** card — textarea (email signature), save button wired to a new `updateStudioMessagingAction` — see step 7
5. **Business Hours** card — 7-day/hour matrix OR simple start/end time pair per weekday; save button also via `updateStudioMessagingAction`

Each card: `rounded-xl border border-border bg-background p-6 shadow-card`. Card header: `text-h2` title + Stone subtitle + optional right-side action button (e.g. "+ Add rule" on Auto-reply card).

### 3. `components/settings/messaging/ChannelConnectionsCard.tsx`
Props: `{ channels: ChannelStatus[] }` where `ChannelStatus = { key: Channel, connected: boolean, providerLabel: string }`.

Render 6 rows (SMS, Email, Instagram, WhatsApp, Web chat, Phone), each:
- Left: ChannelIcon (reuse `components/messages/ChannelIcon.tsx`) + channel label + provider label (Stone caption "via Twilio" / "via Resend" / "via Meta" etc.)
- Right: status badge
  - Connected: small Onyx pill "Connected"
  - Not connected: Stone pill "Not connected" + outline "Connect" button (disabled for IG/WA/WebChat/Phone w/ tooltip "Provider credentials coming soon")
- Hairline Stone border between rows

### 4. `components/settings/messaging/AutoReplyRulesCard.tsx`
Props: `{ rules: AutoReplyRule[] w/ template joined, templates: MessageTemplate[] }`

- Card header: "Auto-replies" + subtitle "InkOS replies for you when a new inquiry, missed call, or keyword is detected." + right action: "+ Add rule" outline button (opens `RuleEditorSheet`)
- For each rule, a row:
  - Trigger label (capitalized from trigger_type + optional keyword: "New inquiry" / "Keyword: reschedule" / "Missed call" / "Deposit paid")
  - Template name (Stone)
  - Cooldown minutes (Stone caption)
  - Tone pill
  - Right: Switch (toggle enabled via `toggleRuleAction`) + Edit icon button (opens `RuleEditorSheet` w/ rule) + Delete icon button (destructive, confirmation)
- Empty state: "No auto-replies configured. Add one to never miss an inquiry again."

### 5. `components/settings/messaging/RuleEditorSheet.tsx`
ActionSheet-based editor. Props: `{ open, onClose, rule?, templates }`.

Form (react-hook-form + Zod if existing pattern; else controlled state):
- Trigger type select (radio or Select): new_inquiry / missed_call / deposit_paid / keyword
- Keyword input (only shown when type=keyword)
- Template select (lists templates filtered to matching channel later if needed)
- Cooldown minutes number input (default 60)
- Tone radio: Casual / Formal
- Enabled switch (default on)
- Footer: Cancel (ghost) + Save (Onyx primary, calls `createRuleAction` or `updateRuleAction`)

Zod schema inline, identical shape to server action.

### 6. `components/settings/messaging/TemplatesTable.tsx`
Props: `{ templates: MessageTemplate[] }`

- Header row: "Templates" + subtitle "Saved replies you can insert with `/` in any conversation." + right actions: "+ New template" outline button (opens `TemplateEditorSheet`) and "Restore defaults" ghost button (calls `seedDefaultTemplatesAction`)
- Tab filter row (above table): All / Aftercare / Deposit / Booking / Portfolio / Reschedule / Inquiry reply / Custom — styled same as conversation list filter pills (ghost w/ active Onyx)
- Table columns: Name · Channel (icon) · Category pill · Keywords (chip list, truncated) · Body preview (Stone, 60 chars truncate, font-mono text-caption) · Actions (Edit / Delete icon buttons)
- Row hover: subtle Onyx-4% bg
- Empty state: "No templates yet. Restore defaults to get started."
- Default templates marked with a small Stone badge "Default" next to name

### 7. `components/settings/messaging/TemplateEditorSheet.tsx`
ActionSheet-based editor. Props: `{ open, onClose, template? }`.

Form:
- Name input
- Slug input (auto-generated from name via slugify; editable; shown w/ Stone caption "/t/<slug>")
- Channel select (Both / SMS only / Email only)
- Category select
- Trigger keywords input (chip-style; type keyword + Enter to add)
- Body textarea (monospace, tall 240px)
- Token hint row: "Available variables" + inline code chips `{{studio_name}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{portfolio_link}}`, `{{aftercare_pdf_link}}` — click to insert into textarea at cursor
- Preview panel (right side on wide screens, stacked on mobile): renders body with tokens substituted using mock values
- Footer: Cancel + Save (calls `createTemplateAction` or `updateTemplateAction`)

### 8. Studio columns for signature + business hours + tone
Check if `studios` table already has columns `email_signature text`, `messaging_business_hours jsonb`, `messaging_tone text default 'casual'`. If yes — use them. If no — create a small follow-up migration `20260423110000_studio_messaging_settings.sql` adding the columns (nullable, default where applicable) + regenerate types via surgical edit if DB offline (same pattern Dato used).

### 9. Studio settings update action
Add to `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts` OR create new `app/(app)/settings/messaging/actions.ts`:
```
updateStudioMessagingAction({ signature?, businessHours?, tone? })
```
Zod-validated, auth-guarded, calls `supabase.from('studios').update(...)` with studio id + RLS.

### 10. Sidebar integration
Update `app/(app)/settings/` sidebar or `components/settings/` nav config to include "Messaging" entry. Look for the existing settings nav pattern (likely `components/settings/SettingsSidebar.tsx` or similar) — add the entry in the appropriate group (between Studio and Billing probably). Link to `/settings/messaging`. Icon: MessageSquare from lucide.

If `app/(app)/settings/layout.tsx` or `app/(app)/settings/SettingsShell.tsx` drives nav, update the nav items array there. Grep for `'/settings/studio'` to find nav declaration pattern.

### 11. Brand compliance (non-negotiable)
- NO raw hex in components (tokens only)
- NO default tailwind shadows — use shadow-soft / shadow-card / shadow-soft-md
- NO indigo / amber / green / pink / yellow classes
- NO `any` type
- NO `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` if needed server-side
- Serif Instrument only on page title / empty-state names — never body/labels/data
- Rust earned — Rust only for: destructive confirm buttons, toggle ON indicator (minimal), nothing else here
- Every icon-only button has `aria-label`
- Zod on every action input client→server

### 12. Verification
```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm build
```
All must pass.

Grep brand check:
```bash
grep -rn "indigo\|amber\|emerald\|green-\|pink-\|yellow\|shadow-sm\|shadow-md\|shadow-lg\|shadow-xl\|shadow-2xl" app/\(app\)/settings/messaging components/settings/messaging
```
Must return zero hits.

## Deliverables
1. All files listed (including any studio-column migration if needed)
2. Verification output
3. Sidebar nav updated so users can reach the page
4. Report back with files changed and any blockers

Execute. Do not ask permission mid-build. Batch edits. Under 1200 tokens of report back.

3	## Context
4	
5	Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. No tattoo SaaS combines Mangomint's conversation-state depth + Inkedin's 5-channel consolidation + InkDesk's client-context sidebar + LucentDesk's auto-reply triage. InkOS owns that wedge.
6	
7	Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.
8	
9	Rebuild `/messages` into **3-pane + slide-in 4th context pane**, add triage tagging, auto-reply engine, smart reply chips (rule-based, AI-hook clean), composer power features, assignment + typing presence, internal notes, templates library, schedule send, and mass blast entry point. Ship SMS + Email fully working; Instagram / WhatsApp / Web chat / Voice = UI shell + stub webhook routes + schema-ready (flip env to activate when creds land).

15	## Scope
16	
17	### v1 — ships this build
18	- 3-pane layout (channel rail + conversation list + thread panel) + toggleable context pane
19	- 7-channel rail (SMS, Email, Instagram, WhatsApp, Web chat, Phone, All) — SMS + Email fully working; others render channel + "Connect provider" empty state when unconfigured

Enables full 3-pane w/ shallow routing (preserves scroll state + channel + filter). Mobile still drills down via conditional render. **Delete** `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/` dir.

69	### New migration: `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql`
70	1. **`conversations` ALTER:**
71	   - `triage_tag text CHECK (triage_tag IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'))` nullable
72	   - `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable (auto-close pattern from Mangomint)
73	   - `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable (debounces re-fires)

88	   - Unique: `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` (nulls distinct for single-trigger rules)
89	   - RLS: studio_members SELECT; owner/admin ALL
90	5. **New RPC `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`:**
91	   - Loads conv + latest inbound message + client (if any) + upcoming bookings
92	   - Applies deterministic rules (spec in "Triage rules" below)

106	```

110	ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
111	ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
112	ELSE                                              → client
113	```
